content:
It'd better if you could consider setting the status of your contribution to WIP to allow for a proper review and necessary adjustments before opening it for approval by others.

I haven't reviewed the puzzle in detail yet. The following points are based on a quick initial scan:

Goal & Output
* Please format "IMPOSSIBLE" as a {{constant}}.

Cases
* Please add intermediate cases (including at least one more pair of cases that expect IMPOSSIBLE) to cover the full ranges of [[n]], [[closedCost]] and [[openCost]] more evenly. Don't always rely on either very small values or very large values.

Cover picture
* Please upload a cover picture for the puzzle.

Thanks.
